report:
Reviewed the complete claim, one ordinary implementation association and all four tests. LocalFnSym in fns.rs identifies definitions by name, scope and owner, keeping CST and absolute span in tracked fields; signature and body are separate symbol-keyed queries, not identity fields. This supports distinguishing identity inputs from changing detail inputs without claiming the full per-kind reuse matrix is proven.

The detail_edits_preserve_local_symbol_query_keys test warms observers and asserts no observer execution after detail changes across function, struct, enum, trait, impl, alias, const, static, module, use and macro definitions/invocations. enum_detail_edits_preserve_variant_query_keys checks variant fields and observer reuse after a field-type change. moving_associated_items_preserves_symbol_query_keys checks owner equality and identity-observer reuse for trait/impl functions, types and constants through sibling insertion, reorder and reverse edits, exercising changed positions/spans. Captured setup_root_module, the interned ObservedSymbol and tracked observer, plus WillExecute logging and draining show these are meaningful identity-key reuse checks: reminting the key would execute the observer. Assertions remain visible in the annotated tests.

The explicit symbols_local_identity TODO retains per-kind sibling insertion/reordering and signature/member/body consumer reuse coverage. Completing it requires the expanded per-kind edit matrix, observing unchanged sibling facts and changed facts, including genuine identity-change comparisons; the current identity-field declaration supports distinguishability but current ordinary tests do not establish that full matrix. This accepted verification deferral stays TODO; its empty body proves nothing. No N/A evidence exists. All claim aspects are covered by the current source/examples or this retained broader matrix prerequisite, and no additional edits are requested.

Baseline: independently compared all three historical implementation_sources/test_sources snapshots against current files and confirmed exact equality. Reassessed the historical rationale against current claim, metadata, complete test bodies and captured helpers rather than treating the earlier verdict as approval. Execution: ran review start/read and this record workflow and the comparison script; no behavior tests or build executed by this reviewer. The coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and root cargo build are separate execution evidence, not execution of these harness cases by me.
